description: This Java class 'LegacyApsAckedCommandEvent' extends 'ClusterCommandEvent' and manages sending command events with acknowledgment handling in a ZigBee-like environment. It includes mechanisms for waiting for acknowledgment responses, tracking command IDs, and handling sequence numbers.

classes.name: LegacyApsAckedCommandEvent
classes.description: Represents a command event that waits for an APS acknowledgment, encapsulating logic for sending commands and processing acknowledgments.

classes.name: ApsAckEventWaitHelper
classes.description: Inner class extending EventWaitHelper, used to wait for acknowledgment responses and store command IDs.

methods.name: LegacyApsAckedCommandEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with specified parameters such as EUI, endpoint, command, RSSI, and LQI.

methods.name: apsAckReceived
methods.description: Static method to handle receiving an acknowledgment, updating the wait helper with the command and notifying waiters.

methods.name: sendAndWait
methods.description: Sends the command event and waits for an acknowledgment within a specified timeout, returning the command ID received.
